mara-cs: AuroraHead (dedicated) reports UI lag during peak billing window; p95 up ~20% last 48h, errors low. Renewal check in 4w, want to be proactive.

leo-ops: Any client changes?

mara-cs: They started longer summaries in requests (avg tokens ~700) and a marketing surge +25% traffic. Suspect KV churn and longer decode plays.

ina-ml: Quick recommendation: route very short queries (<=256 tokens) to micro-compact-int8, short (257-512) to compact-fp16, long >512 to base-fp16. This reduces p95 tail without altering long-context quality.

sam-se: Need QA checklist pre-canary: top-10 intent regression, PII output scan, SLA impact note, and rollback trigger (auto if p95 > baseline*1.12).

ina-ml: Canary plan: 12h, 15% of eligible short-query traffic, metrics: p50/p95, top_intent_f1, hallucination_rate, token-cost delta. Rollback if F1 drops >0.03 or p95 exceeds threshold.

mara-cs: I'll get PM sign-off and mention proactive perf work in renewal tracker.

leo-ops: I'll prewarm KV caches and add prefix cache TTL=3m. Will throttle if QPS >3.5k.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: #canary-9812 scheduled in 40m :rocket:

mara-cs: Next steps: PM approval, run canary, collect evals, decide. Posting as a PSR in account notes. /end
